title: Exact Spin Elimination for Quadratic and k-Local Ising Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2505.07163v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ising solvers have a finite spin budget. Quadratization uses auxiliary spins to replace higher-order interactions by pairwise ones. We show that removing spins while allowing more complex interactions can fit larger problems within the same spin budget and improve optimization. Walsh elimination minimizes over one spin at a time, writes the resulting interaction as a sum of spin products in the Walsh basis, and stores a rule for recovering the removed spin. Explicit resource limits control which eliminations are accepted. In a held-out test with the protocol frozen before instance generation and one annealing schedule shared by both formulations, mean observed success rises from 10.4% to 97.5% on sparse quadratic spin glasses and from 16.9% to 87.5% on three-body problems. Observed success increases on every instance with a verified reference minimum, and pooled time-to-solution estimates decrease by factors of about 34 and 11,

translated_title: 面向二次型与k-局部伊辛优化的精确自旋消元方法
translated_abstract: 伊辛求解器的自旋数量是有限的。二次化方法使用辅助自旋将高阶相互作用替换为成对相互作用。我们证明，在允许更复杂相互作用的前提下移除自旋，可以在相同的自旋预算内容纳更大规模的问题并改善优化效果。沃尔什消元法每次对一个自旋进行最小化，将所得相互作用表示为沃尔什基底下自旋乘积之和，并存储一条用于恢复被移除自旋的规则。显式的资源限制用于控制哪些消元操作被接受。在一项协议于实例生成前冻结、且两种表述共享同一退火调度方案的保留测试中，稀疏二次自旋玻璃问题上的平均观测成功率从10.4%提升至97.5%，三体问题上的成功率从16.9%提升至87.5%。在每一个具有经验证参考最小值的实例上，观测成功率均有所提升，汇总的求解时间估计分别降低约34倍和11倍。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于沃尔什消元的精确自旋消元方法，通过移除自旋并允许更复杂的相互作用，在相同自旋预算下显著扩大可求解问题的规模，使伊辛优化成功率分别提升至97.5%和87.5%，求解时间降低约34倍和11倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an exact spin elimination method based on Walsh elimination, which removes spins while allowing more complex interactions to fit larger problems within the same spin budget, boosting Ising optimization success rates to 97.5% and 87.5% and reducing time-to-solution by factors of about 34 and 11.
